from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Optional
import dacite
@dataclass
class Action:
    """
    An action/function/operation to be performed
    """
    pageTitle:str
    purpose:Optional[str] # The purpose of the action
    servicetype:Optional[str] # The type of the service
    service:Optional[str] # The service to be used
    inputtype:Optional[str] # What is the type of the input?
    input:Optional[str] # the description of the input e.g. a page name, url or SMW ask query
    actionpage:Optional[str] # What page will 'steer' this action?
    output:Optional[str] # the typed description of the output - parameter names and types like the input; prose belongs into the comment field
    engine:Optional[str] # the processing engine to be used either [[Rythm]] or [[Freemarker]]
    author:Optional[str] # the author of this action
    since:Optional[str] # since when is this action available?
    comment:Optional[str] # a comment for the action
    agent:Optional[str] # the agent performing this action
    name:Optional[str] # The name of the Action

    @classmethod
    def askQuery(cls):
        """
        get the ask Query for Action

        Returns:
            str: the mediawiki markup for the ask query
        """
        ask="""{{#ask: [[Concept:Action]]
|mainlabel=pageTitle
|?Action purpose = purpose
|?Action servicetype = servicetype
|?Action service = service
|?Action inputtype = inputtype
|?Action input = input
|?Action actionpage = actionpage
|?Action output = output
|?Action engine = engine
|?Action author = author
|?Action since = since
|?Action comment = comment
|?Action agent = agent
|?Action name = name
|limit=10000
|format=table
}}"""
        return ask

    @classmethod
    def fromDict(cls,data:dict):
        """
        create a Action from the given dict

        Args:
            data(dict): the dict to create the Action from

        Returns:
            Action: the freshly created Action
        """
        action=dacite.from_dict(data_class=cls,data=data)
        return action
